description: OpenAI Ads Measurement Pixel image fallback requests to bzr.openai.com/v1/sdk/events.

params.name: pid
params.description: It is the Pixel ID, and the image tag requires it.
params.fix_hint: Set `pid` to the Pixel ID from OpenAI Ads.

params.name: event
params.description: It is a supported event name, or `custom`. OpenAI documents the image tag as requiring it.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to a documented name such as `page_viewed`, or to `custom` with `custom_event_name`.

params.name: data[type]
params.description: It names the data shape for the event. OpenAI documents it as required on the image tag, and unknown fields are rejected.
params.fix_hint: Set `data[type]` to the shape documented for this event, such as `contents`.

params.name: custom_event_name
params.description: It names a custom event. OpenAI documents it as required when `event` is `custom`.

params.name: event_id
params.description: It identifies the event for deduplication against the Conversions API. Use the same value as CAPI `id`.
params.fix_hint: Send the same `event_id` the Conversions API event uses as `id`.

rules.message: `event` is `custom` but `custom_event_name` is missing. OpenAI documents that name as required for custom events.
rules.fix_hint: Add `custom_event_name` with the custom event name.
